beats: I wanted to drill one word - but had to sit through an entire story to reach it.
Every sentence buried it in a narrative, and uploading a document just read the whole file aloud.
Now a new lesson format builds a pool of just the words that matter, using Claude.
Like flashcards instead of a novel - each word stands alone, with its own checked sentences.
Ask for the 20 most common adverbs, and that's exactly what you get to drill.
